findings.claim: Public field selection is inverted. `IsPublicReadWrite` keeps only `readonly` fields (`field.IsReadOnly && !field.IsConst`). As a result, ordinary public mutable fields of T are silently left out of the contractless formatter, which loses data on round-trip. Public `readonly` fields are included instead, so the generated code tries to assign to them on deserialize. This breaks the criterion 'contractless behaviour over public members', and it contradicts the attribute docs and README ('every public, read-write instance property and field').

receipt_plan.detail: Run Receipts.GeneratedTests.GeneratedFormatterContractlessFidelityTests.PublicMutableField_IsSerializedInContractlessMode. ProjectA.MyObject has `public string FieldMember;`. On head the generated formatter source does not contain FieldMember, so the test fails.

findings.claim: Attributes on T are never honoured. When no SurrogateType is set, the collector always calls CreateContractlessMembers(type). It ignores [MessagePackObject]/[Key]/[IgnoreMember] and [DataContract]/[DataMember] on T, so members excluded by T's own contract are still serialized under name keys. This misses the acceptance criterion 'If T does carry MessagePack attributes, they are honoured'. It also misses the maintainer rule that contractless applies only when T has no [DataContract] or [MessagePackObject].

receipt_plan.detail: Run Receipts.GeneratedTests.GeneratedFormatterContractlessFidelityTests.DataContractAttributesOnReferencedType_AreHonoured and MessagePackAttributesOnReferencedType_AreHonoured. On head the generated formatter contains the non-DataMember / [IgnoreMember] member name, so both tests fail.
